metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the `ical` CLI (Node.js 22+, standard library only) in `output/`:

- Entry point: `output/main.js`
- Subcommands:
  - `node output/main.js parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
  - `node output/main.js expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO> --to <ISO> --output <out.json>`

Key files:
- `output/ics_lexer.js`, `output/ics_parser.js`: RFC 5545 content-line parsing (unfolding, params) + RFC 6868 param unescaping + warnings.
- `output/component_mapper.js`: Maps VCALENDAR/VEVENT/VTODO/VJOURNAL/VFREEBUSY/VTIMEZONE/VAVAILABILITY/AVAILABLE/VALARM into the required JSON schemas (including `raw_properties`).
- `output/rrule_parse.js`, `output/rrule_expand.js`: RRULE parse + expansion (Gregorian; emits `rscale_unsupported` for non-Gregorian `RSCALE`).
- `output/tz_resolver.js`: In-file `VTIMEZONE` resolver used by `expand`, including fold/nonexistent warnings.
- `output/expand.js`: Expands VEVENT instances over `[--from, --to)`, applies `RDATE`/`EXDATE`/`RECURRENCE-ID` overrides, emits sorted `occurrences`.

No `package.json` / no external dependencies.
